editorial_policy: Recommendation first. Commission never determines inclusion or placement.

resources.name: The Light in the Window
resources.why_recommended: The founding story behind the movement and the people who left the light on.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: Readers interested in foster care, family, belonging, and the movement’s origin.

resources.name: Leave One Light On
resources.why_recommended: The practical invitation that grew from the founding story, with achievable ways to practice compassion, hospitality, hope, and faithful presence.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: Readers looking for practical ways to carry the movement’s message into everyday life.

resources.name: The Light in the Window — publisher page
resources.why_recommended: A direct publisher page for the founding story.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: Readers who prefer to learn about the book from its publisher.

resources.name: Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing
resources.why_recommended: Official tools and documentation for independently publishing print and Kindle books.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: Writers comparing self-publishing pathways and requirements.

resources.name: InkFluence
resources.why_recommended: A publishing platform Ted has used for book pages linked from this site. Review its current services and terms before deciding whether it fits your work.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: Writers researching publishing support and book presentation options.

resources.name: Child Welfare Information Gateway
resources.why_recommended: A federal information service with publications and resources about child welfare, foster care, and adoption.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: Families, educators, professionals, and people beginning careful research.

resources.name: U.S. Department of Education — Students in Foster Care
resources.why_recommended: Federal information related to educational stability and support for students in foster care.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: Educators, caregivers, students, and community partners.

resources.name: American Red Cross Blood Services
resources.why_recommended: Helps eligible donors understand blood donation and find appointments.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: People considering a direct, often anonymous act of practical compassion.

resources.name: AdoptUSKids
resources.why_recommended: A federally funded national project connecting families with responsible state, territorial, and tribal foster-care and adoption systems.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: People exploring foster parenting or adoption from foster care.

resources.why_recommended: Connects people with local health and human-service information.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: Anyone unsure which local service or support may fit a family’s need.

resources.name: MENTOR — Mentoring Connector
resources.why_recommended: Helps people find screened youth-mentoring programs by location and program type.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: Adults exploring structured mentoring and families seeking programs.

resources.name: VolunteerMatch
resources.why_recommended: A searchable directory of volunteer opportunities offered by participating organizations.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: People looking for service that fits their location, interests, skills, and time.

resources.name: W3C Web Accessibility Initiative
resources.why_recommended: Authoritative accessibility standards, explanations, and implementation guidance.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: Teams creating digital resources that should welcome people with disabilities.

resources.name: Google Search Console
resources.why_recommended: Official tools for understanding search visibility, indexing, and technical search issues.
resources.who_may_find_helpful: Website stewards responsible for search health and content discoverability.
